summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Sir William Boleyn (1451 – 10 October 1505), son of Sir Geoffrey Boleyn, a wealthy mercer and Lord Mayor of London, and Anne Hoo. It identifies him as the father of Thomas Boleyn, 1st Earl of Wiltshire, and therefore the paternal grandfather of Anne Boleyn, the second queen of King Henry VIII.
one_line: Sir William Boleyn (1451–1505), son of London Lord Mayor Geoffrey Boleyn and father of Thomas Boleyn, grandfather of Anne Boleyn.
key_facts: Sir William Boleyn lived from 1451 to 10 October 1505.
Sir William Boleyn was the son of Sir Geoffrey Boleyn.
Sir Geoffrey Boleyn was described as a wealthy mercer and Lord Mayor of London.
Sir William Boleyn's mother was named Anne Hoo.
Sir William Boleyn was the father of Thomas Boleyn, 1st Earl of Wiltshire.
Sir William Boleyn was the paternal grandfather of Anne Boleyn.
Anne Boleyn was the second Queen of King Henry VIII.
